In Fast/31087/2022

 Versus
 The Ex Engineer Lift Irrigation Office And Others
 ...
Advocate for Applicants : Mr. Barate Annasaheb Rajendra
Advocate for Respondent no.1 : Mr. Ruturaj C. Patil

Agp for Respondent nos.2 & 3 : Mrs.D.S.Jape
 ...

With Civil Application No. 6378 Of 2025 In Fast/30622/2022
 With Civil Application No. 6376 Of 2025 In Fast/31083/2022
 ...

Coram : Abhay S. Waghwase, J.
 Date : 09 July, 2025

Per Court :-
 1.
Heard rival submissions.

2. The applicants are seeking withdrawal of the entire amount of compensation, which has been
deposited by the respondent Acquiring Body alongwith interest accrued thereon.

3. The learned counsel for the respondent Acquiring Body opposed the application on the ground
that though the compensation granted is within four times, but the interest under Section 28 of the
Land Acquisition Act is awarded from the date of possession.

In view of the same and considering the enhancement granted by the Reference Court, the applicants are permitted to withdraw 50% of the deposited amount of compensation alongwith the proportionate interest accrued thereon till date on usual undertaking to the satisfaction of the Govind So Shankar Jadhav vs The Ex Engineer Lift Irrigation Office ... on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2664411/
1 Registrar (Judicial) of this Court.

sentences.text: Applicants are also permitted to withdraw 25% of the deposited amount of compensation alongwith the proportionate interest accrued thereon till date on furnishing solvent surety to the satisfaction of the Registrar (Judicial) of this Court.
The remaining 25% amount be kept in FDR in any Nationalized Bank on yearly renewal basis till final disposal of the appeals.
5. The Civil Applications are accordingly disposed of.
